heading.title: Five stages.
heading.description: You see working software in week three and every Friday after that. Nothing about our process requires you to take our word for it.

items.title: Signal
items.blurb: A 45-minute call and a short written brief. We pressure-test the problem before anyone talks solutions.

items.title: Blueprint
items.blurb: Architecture, scope, and a clickable prototype. You get a fixed plan with named risks — not a vague statement of work.

items.title: Forge
items.blurb: Two-week sprints, demo every Friday, main always deployable. You watch it get built in your own repo.

items.title: Launch
items.blurb: Load tested, instrumented, documented. We ship behind flags and stay on call through the ramp.

items.title: Compound
items.blurb: Post-launch retainer or a clean handover with recorded walkthroughs. Your team owns it either way.
